subject: Medallion AI: monthly token tiers, concurrency stresspoints, and pricing sensitivity
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@medallion.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + ask: monthly token tiers, peak TPS, and $/1M target

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can get a pricing preview over to procurement.

Call highlights (from our side):
- Primary use case: personalized product descriptions + summarization for merchant catalogs (latency-sensitive on checkout flows).
- Expected baseline: mostly short-context requests (~150 tokens average).
- Spiky traffic around product launches and Black Friday-like events.

Can you confirm the following by EOD?
1) Monthly token range you expect for the first 3 months (best / expected / high): e.g. 50M / 200M / 1B tokens.
2) Peak concurrent generation TPS (not average) you need to support during spikes — we heard ~120 TPS but wanted firm confirmation.
3) Target budget band and target $/1M tokens you are hoping to hit for hosted API (helps us show committed vs burst economics).
4) Any procurement requirements (PO terms, invoice cadence, specific contract language) we should include in the preview.

I attached a short pricing preview so you can see how committed tiers and burst capacity map to unit price.

Next steps from us once you confirm the items above: finalize a 1-page commercial (tier + $/1M + burst policy) and route to procurement for signatures.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.co@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0103
[Attachment: redwood_pricing_preview.pdf (pdf)]
From: Samir Patel <samir@medallion.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Qureshi <aisha.qureshi@medallion.ai>, Procurement <procurement@medallion.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: monthly token tiers, peak TPS, and $/1M target

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. See answers inline:  

1) Monthly tokens (3-month view)
- Best case (pilot): 25M / month
- Expected (Q1 launch): 180M / month
- High (post-launch growth): 900M - 1.1B / month

2) Peak TPS during spikes
- Normal peak: 60-80 TPS sustained for short windows (minutes)
- Heavy spike (campaigns): up to ~150 TPS for ~20-45 minutes max

3) Budget / $/1M target
- We are internal-targeting $18–$26 per 1M tokens for hosted API at scale, with ability to consider higher initial pilot pricing if there is a firm path to commit.

4) Procurement notes
- Standard SOW + master services agreement. Net 60 preferred. Need an initial PO for pilot.

Cc'ing Aisha and Procurement so we can get a sense of timing. Attached: sample internal forecast we referenced.

Samir
Head of Product, Medallion AI
samir@medallion.ai | +1 (650) 555-0977
[Attachment: medallion_forecast_q1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@medallion.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Procurement <procurement@medallion.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: monthly token tiers, peak TPS, and $/1M target

Thanks Samir — this is super helpful. Based on the ranges you shared, here's a concise sensitivity sketch so procurement can see concrete dollars by tier and burst assumptions. I attached a CSV with simplified line-item math.

Quick sensitivity (ASSUMPTIONS: avg tokens per request = 150):
- Pilot (25M/mo): unit price if uncommitted hosted pay-as-you-go ~ $48 / 1M tokens; with a 3-month 25M commit we can get to ~$30 / 1M.
- Scale (180M/mo expected): committed 6–12 month range gets to $22–$19 / 1M depending on burst allowance.
- High (900M–1.1B/mo): committed annual tiers + Reserved capacity path -> $14–$17 / 1M.

Burst / peak TPS notes:
- Short spikes to 150 TPS are handled via burst capacity; burst is priced as a metered premium if above committed sustained throughput.
- If Medallion needs guaranteed low-latency at 150 TPS sustained for >30 minutes, we should evaluate a Dedicated or Reserved burst pool (different commercial).

Proposal / next steps:
1) I'll produce a 1-page commercial showing two options: (A) 3-month pilot commit (25M/mo) with option to convert to a 12-month tier; (B) 12-month committed band for 180M/mo with defined burst policy.
2) If procurement is comfortable with Net 60 and sample PO, we can attach the commercial for sign-off and kick off a 2-week pilot.
3) Karthik, can you confirm whether a short-term dedicated burst SKU is something we can price into the pilot attachment?

Attaching: medallion_commit_sensitivity.csv (line item math + scenario rows).

Best —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.co@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0103
[Attachment: medallion_commit_sensitivity.csv (csv)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@medallion.ai>
Cc: marissa.co@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + ask: monthly token tiers, peak TPS, and $/1M target

Samir — appreciate the clarity. Two quick notes from a rollout/ops perspective:  

1) Pilot approach: we can do a 3-month pilot at the 25M/month commit with an explicit conversion path to the 12-month 180M tier. That gives you a price ladder and predictable step-up.
2) Dedicated/burst: for any sustained 150 TPS windows longer than ~30 minutes we recommend a short Reserved burst pool; we can include a capped monthly charge for that in the commercial.

I'll ask legal to prep a simplified commercial (1 page) once Marissa confirms the exact pilot start date. Samir — are you available next Tue for a procurement handoff call? (Marissa will book if yes).

Linking the deal in HubSpot and initial DocuSign stub: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4891 | https://www.docusign.com/en/medallion-redwood-poc

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0117
